source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: fidget.lua initializes the options, then listens for progress messages from LSP servers (progress/lsp.lua). These are converted into notifications, handled by a model (notification/model.lua) and drawn in a floating window by view.lua and window.lua.
